1.As per Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Board sought approval from the Shareholders of the Company by passing of Special resolution at the 64th Annual General Meeting of the Company held on 21.06.2025 for the reappointment of Mr N Gopalaratnam (DIN:00001945), who retires by rotation and offered himself for reappointment to continue as a Director (Non Executive - Non Independent Director )of the Company despite he has attained the age of 75 years. Mr N Gopalaratnam, who is the presently the Non Executive Chairman and Non Independent Director of the Company is associated with the company actively since 1991 and under his stewardship, the Company has witnessed tremendous growth and performance. In the opinion of the Board, Mr. N Gopalaratnam is suitable for being continued as Director of the Company. The Resolution for the Re-appointment of retiring Director, Mr N Gopalaratnam (DIN:00001945) has been passed with requisite majority as a Special Resolution in the 64th AGM held on 21st June, 2025. The percentage of votes cast in favour of the resolution was 100% of the total votes polled. The percentage of votes polled in favour of the resolution was 51.62% of the total Share Capital of the Company. The AGM Notice and e-voting results was filed with BSE and uploaded in Company's Website and also on the website of CDSL.
2. The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 18.03.2023, Reappointed Dr. G A Pathanjali (DIN: 05297665), as Managing Director of the company for a period of Three (3) years from 01st April 2023 to 31st March 2026. The Shareholders at the 62nd AGM held on 24.06.2023 approved the said appointment with requisite majority. The AGM notice and e-voting results was filed with BSE and uploaded in Company's Website.
3. The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 21.01.2025 have re-appointed Mr.M Ignatius (DIN:08463140), as Whole time director designated as Director (Operations) of the Company for a period of 3 years with effect from 01.04.2025 and approved the Postal Ballot Notice to seek Shareholder's approval for the re-appointment by Special Resolution. The soft copy of the Postal Ballot notice dated 21.01.25 was sent by the company on 13.02.25 to the registered email id's of the shareholders as on the cut-off date ie.07.02.25 in order to communicate their assent or dissent through the Remote e-voting system. The Remote e-voting system commenced on Monday, the 17th February,2025 (09:00 AM) and completed on Tuesday, the 18th March, 2025(05:00 PM). On 19.03.2025, based on the Scrutinizer's Report the Company declared the E-voting results of the Postal Ballot for the Re-appointment of Mr M Ignatius, Whole time Director, designated as Director (Operations) of the Company. The Special Resolution relating to the Re-appointment of Mr. M Ignatius (DIN:08463140) as Whole time Director, designated as Director (Operations) of the Company for a period of 3 years with effect from 01.04.25, was passed with requisite Special majority through Postal Ballot. The percentage of votes cast in favour of the resolution was 99.99 % of the total votes polled. The percentage of votes polled in favour of the resolution was 50.04 % of the total Share Capital of the Company. The Postal Ballot E-voting results was intimated to the Stock Exchange and posted at website of the company and on the website of CDSL.
